resources.string: This activity has been submitted and can no longer be changed. An administrator can still correct it.
Calendar periods with a count greater than one are not supported yet because their alignment anchor is not defined.
Optional date shown on the certificate, for example the examination date.
Only the activities of #VAR1# are shown.
Only the activities credited to #VAR1# are shown.
The requirement period each contribution is credited to. Defaults to the activity begin date.
Tracks member activities and recurring training, certification, continuing-education, and similar requirements.
Members may always edit and delete their own activities
Controls whether submitting an activity locks it against later member changes. Administrators can still review and correct records.
Members may edit and delete only draft activities
Allowed file types: #VAR1#. At most #VAR2# MiB per file and #VAR3# files per activity.

Comma-separated list of the file types members may attach, for example "pdf,jpg,png". Leave empty to allow every supported type. Only pdf, jpg and png can be stored; anything else in the list is ignored.
Certificate files are switched off for this organization.

Members may attach the certificate they received to an activity, so that a reviewer can check the claim against the evidence. The files are stored outside the web directory and are only ever readable by the member the activity belongs to and by the requirements administrators.
How many files may be attached to one activity.
The size limit of a single file. The server upload limit still applies and may be lower.
No certificate has been attached to this activity yet.
The certificate storage of this organization is full (#VAR1#). Delete some files or raise the quota.
The activity was saved, but the file was not attached: #VAR1#
This activity already has the maximum of #VAR1# files.
The total size of all certificates of this organization. 0 means no limit.
A file of type #VAR1# cannot be attached. Allowed are: #VAR2#.
The file type could not be determined, so the file was not accepted. The PHP extension "fileinfo" has to be installed for certificate uploads.
If selected, no begin or end time is stored for this activity.
A credit column adds a contribution for that requirement. The period column beside it is optional; without it the contribution is credited to the period the activity falls in.

Import activities and their credits from a CSV or spreadsheet file. Nothing is written until you have seen the preview and confirmed it. Columns whose heading is one of the following names are assigned automatically:

An activity counts as already existing when the same member has one with the same title and begin date, or one with the same source key. There is no default: whether a repeated row is a correction or a second attendance is a decision only you can make.
With headings, columns whose heading is a known field name are assigned automatically. Without them, every column has to be assigned by hand.
Assign exactly one of these columns. A name needs both halves, and a name that several members of this organization share is reported instead of being guessed.
The first rows of the file
#VAR1# rows read: #VAR2# would be imported, #VAR3# skipped, #VAR4# with errors.
#VAR1# rows read: #VAR2# imported, #VAR3# skipped, #VAR4# with errors.
#VAR1# of #VAR2# rows are shown: those with errors first, then the skipped ones.
Name or number of the worksheet to import. Leave empty for the first one. Ignored for a CSV file.
The activity end date must not be before its begin date.
The rule validity end date must not be before its start date.
Member on the first day of the period
If enabled, the obligation only arises when the user was a member of the role on the first day of the requirement period.
How the obligations of several qualifying roles are combined for one member.
No role rules defined for this requirement type yet.
No requirement is assigned to your current roles.
Number of periods before the running one shown in the fulfilment overview above the activity list. The unit follows each requirement (year, quarter, month or week).
Full amount regardless of partial membership
Pro rata to the qualifying membership
Number of period units. Calendar periods currently support the value 1 only.
Selects the default granularity for newly created pro-rata role rules. The chosen value is stored on each rule so later setting changes do not reinterpret historical rules.
Pick this entry and save to create a provider now; you return to this activity afterwards.
A public provider is visible to every member of the organization. A private provider is visible to its creator and administrators only.
Administrators mark a provider as qualified when its training is recognised.
This provider short name is already in use in a conflicting provider scope.
Optional abbreviation used in imports and reports. Must be unique among public providers, or among your own private providers.
An inactive requirement type is no longer offered for new configuration but existing obligations keep being calculated.
This requirement type still has #VAR1# credited contributions and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead, or remove the contributions first.
This requirement short name is already used in the current organization.
Optional abbreviation used in imports, reports and the fulfilment overview.
The accepted credits replace the claim. An empty field leaves the claim standing; an accepted zero rejects it.
No member is concerned by this requirement in this period.
No requirement type has been configured yet, so there is nothing to review.
Show the activities of this member
This role already has an overlapping rule for the requirement. Correct the validity dates before saving.
Show the activities this period is made up of
Do you want to submit the activity "#VAR1#" for review? Depending on the organization settings you may no longer be able to change it afterwards.
The role "#VAR1#" has both full and pro-rata rules in this period. The higher of the two obligations is used; correct the rules.
The role "#VAR1#" has several full-amount rules in this period. The highest value is used; correct the rules.
